description: Portrait of O'Keeffe standing in her painting studio at her Abiquiu house. She is wearing a black wrap dress and her Hector Aguilar belt with her hands folded at her waist. Behind her is a table of paint brushes and between her are work tables with papers and  boxes, etc., their are2 gesso canvases leaning against a table in the foreground and a large version of the painting, The Black Door, on an easel on the back wall; adobe wall, square vigas, large glass picture windows, flood of sunlight.
title: O'Keeffe relaxes in her studio
